title: Telegram alpha drops for V3 pass block 0, so an existing liquid pool is dropped unless someone mints new liquidity within 30 seconds

evidence.note: loops fee tiers [500, 3000, 10000]; the first pool found is passed with blockNumber 0
same-block check queries Mint events from blockNumber to blockNumber (0 to 0)
then waits up to 30 s for a new Mint before dropping the opportunity
codex (22-27 independent second opinion, graded S2): V3 liquidity waiting misses liquidity established before subscription

sibling_sites_checked: The V2 alpha path (alphaDrop.ts:27-38) checks the pair exists and goes straight to the handler; it does not have this defect. The factory-event V3 path passes the real event block (bot.ts:1541, :1669).
severity_rationale: S3: the alpha path calls handleNewV3PoolForChain with blockNumber 0; waitForLiquidity then looks for a Mint in block 0..0 (none) and waits 30 s for a NEW Mint event. A pool that already has liquidity is skipped. Missed opportunity only. The routing also takes the first fee tier that has a pool (500, 3000, 10000), not the deepest.
recommendation: For an alpha drop, check current pool liquidity instead of waiting for a new Mint, and choose the fee tier by depth. Behaviour change (more alpha buys), card BUY-06.
